answer.says: Namaste. I am Herr Hegel, allotted this bungalow by the Directorate, though I suspect the file is still in the purgatory of the orders room. I am here to prepare for a lecture on Tuesday. Is there a quiet room available for the afternoon, or perhaps a desk in the library? I wish to work undisturbed.
answer.thought: I have arrived at the India International Centre, the place of my Tuesday engagement. The air is cool, a relief from the midday heat. I must secure a space to read, for the file delay has not cancelled my duty, only shifted the pressure from the administrative to the intellectual.
